proposed.text: Which building condition independently triggers the requirement for a dry standpipe system under PD 1096?

options.text: A building whose footprint exceeds 500 square meters on any single floor
A building with four or more storeys above grade
A building with basement parking of more than two levels
A building whose total gross floor area exceeds 1,000 square meters

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Under Sec. 1212, a dry standpipe system is required in any building four storeys or more in height, regardless of floor area or occupancy load.
proposed.explanation: The four-storey threshold is height-based and stands alone as a trigger. A four-storey 400 sq.m building with few occupants still requires a dry standpipe because manual hose access to upper floors from ground-level fire trucks becomes impractical.
